title: TransactionLifecycleEvent
description: One JSONL line: lifecycle status event for a Littio transaction.

event_id.description: Event identifier (uuid-like string). Null/missing → quarantine NULL_PK.

transaction_id.description: Transaction grain key. Null/missing → quarantine NULL_PK.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Known set: PENDING|COMPLETED|FAILED|CANCELLED. Typos (e.g. FAILD) and other values → UNKNOWN_STATUS.

currency.description: ISO-like currency code; no FX blending.

amount.description: Magnitude (string or number). May be unparseable → BAD_AMOUNT. GPV uses abs(parse) when COMPLETED wins.

event_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, or null. Null never wins ordering.

source_file_hint.description: Optional source file hint from export.
